Kit summary

Spirit Blade ThrustBasic
Deals 3 stages of 125% ATK DMG each to a single enemy, with a 50% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. The chance increases to 70% when landing a Crit.
Spirit Blade Full-outActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 3 stages of 205% ATK DMG each to a single enemy. Meanwhile, each stage has a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. The more layers of [Bleed] the target has, the more extra DMG each stage can deal, up to 205%.
Soul’s Edge Lv.1Spirit Blade Full-out: Lukea grants herself a [Shield] by 30% of Lukea's Max HP and [Stealth] for 2 turns after casting it.
Soul GatheringPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Lukea gains 2 pieces of [Soul Fragment] each time she inflicts a kill and gains 1 piece of [Soul Fragment] each time she casts an active skill. Every piece of [Soul Fragment] increases her Leech, SPD, and [Bleed] DMG dealt by 5%. When Lukea has 5 pieces of [Soul Fragment], she will remove all debuffs from self and merge the fragments into a [Soul Core], which increases her Leech, SPD, and [Bleed] DMG dealt by 25%. Lukea will not gain any [Soul Fragment] since then. Instead, she acts for 1 turn immediately and resets the CD of all her active skills.
Soul’s Edge Lv.2Reduces the CD of a random active skill by 1 turn each time Lukea gains 1 piece of [Soul Fragment]. Each [Soul Fragment] additionally increases Lukea’s Piercing Rate by 5%, and [Soul Core] increases her Piercing Rate by 45%.
Spirit Blade OutburstActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 6 stages of 150% ATK DMG each to a single enemy. The first stage inflicts 2 layers of [Bleed] for 2 turns, and each of the following 5 stages has an additional 50% Piercing Rate.
Soul’s Edge Lv.3Inflicts 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns whenever the last 5 stages of Spirit Blade Outburst land a Crit, or there is a 60% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns if no Crit is landed. Besides, while Lukea has the [Soul Core] and each time Spirit Blade Outburst lands a Crit, additionally triggers the effect of 1 layer of [Bleed] 1 time after Spirit Blade Outburst is cast.
Source: game files.
